name: the taste of panic
source:
What was supposed to be a normal day camping with a friend, goes wrong when you get lost. 

reality is shifting right in front of your eyes. you don’t know what to trust anymore. should you believe your eyes or your best friend? you don’t want to think anymore…you are starving. 

[From [url=https://niomeow.itch.io/the-taste-of-panic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本来和朋友一起露营的正常一天，当你迷路时就会变得不那么顺利。

现实就在你眼前发生变化。你不知道该相信什么了。你应该相信你的眼睛还是你最好的朋友？你不想再想了……你快饿死了。

[来自[url=https://niomeow.itch.io/the-taste-of-panic]itch.io[/url]]
